name: Ananya Banerjee
headline: QA Automation Engineer
summary: QA Automation Engineer with a track record of strengthening release confidence through disciplined test coverage, defect analysis, and stable automation suites. Experienced in building repeatable checks, improving test reliability, and partnering with product and development teams to keep delivery predictable. Known for clear reporting, careful investigation, and practical quality improvements across fast-moving teams.

Organized test cases and defect notes for the team, helping engineers resolve issues faster and with fewer handoffs.

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer
